note: What the owner stated.
A rule is the system's own statement: the contract writes it, and the
gates hold it. This register is the other half — the statements the
owner made, kept apart by kind, because they are not the same kind of
thing and a contract that mixes them lies about what it knows.
goal        something to reach. It is not true yet, and it says what
reaching it looks like.
invariant   something that must never stop being true. It says what
holds it: a gate in this repository, or a practice of the
field that the contract can point at but not check.
truth       something that is true now. It says the evidence, and the
evidence is a file in this repository, so a truth that
stops being true fails the gate instead of ageing
quietly.
capability  something that exists. It says where.
A statement carries its provenance: the document in this repository,
the decision record of the field, or the owner's own word with the day
it was said. A statement the owner made to the agent is recorded as
stated, and it is carried into a release to become ratified — the
contract is the owner's word, and the word enters the contract by
being published with it.

statements.what: The contract is what the private frontends absorb, and the absorption is measured rather than asserted: a consumer declares what it keeps, what it renames and what its colours are, and the system's own gate judges it against the contract's guarantees.
statements.done_when: every consumer of record declares its version, its scheme and its own vocabulary, and audits green against the guarantees it claims to keep.
statements.provenance: ROADMAP.md — the order of the whole; and the owner, 2026-10-21

statements.what: The system's own work comes before the field's absorptions, because a contract that cannot express what the field has decided cannot judge the field.
statements.done_when: no absorption is started while a task of the system's own work is open against the same vocabulary.
statements.provenance: ROADMAP.md — the order of the whole

statements.what: One palette across the system: a colour is written once, in the theme, and a consumer declares the colours that are its own content with the reason it carries them.
statements.done_when: no consumer carries a colour the contract does not have, outside the colours it declares as its content.
statements.provenance: core/rules.json COL-001 and COL-004; and the owner, 2026-10-21

statements.what: The contract can be corrected after it has been published, without the correction erasing what it corrects: an element withdrawn stays where it is, marked, with the version that carried it and the reason it was withdrawn.
statements.done_when: the register of retractions exists, every mark travels to the projections a consumer reads, and a gate holds all of it.
statements.provenance: the owner, 2026-10-21 — the right to disqualify retroactively

statements.what: The system is consulted, not only obeyed: a person and an agent can look up what a thing is, what it guarantees, who uses it and where it stands, and see every component in every state.
statements.done_when: the consultation suite answers a lookup, shows the specimen, and shows where each product stands, from the contract's own records and nowhere else.
statements.provenance: the owner, 2026-10-21

statements.what: Nothing is pushed to a repository of the field without the owner's word.
statements.held_by: the field's practice — a branch is prepared, qualified locally and left
statements.provenance: ROADMAP.md — the rule about pushes

statements.what: A tag is the owner's. A release is a deliberate human-controlled transition, and the local release proof is run before the tag is pushed.
statements.held_by: the release job and ci/local-ci.sh --release, and the pre-push hook
statements.provenance: CONTRIBUTING.md — before pushing; ROADMAP.md D-1

statements.what: No change is claimed without the evidence that proves it, and every number the contract states is regenerated by a tool rather than remembered.
statements.held_by: the qualification: tools/gate_expectations.py holds what each gate must say, and tools/audit_frontends.py regenerates the numbers rather than remembering them
statements.provenance: ROADMAP.md — a task without a proof is a wish; ROADMAP.md D-3

statements.what: The gate that judges a consumer is the system's own gate, run at the version the consumer declares. A copy of the gate goes stale, and a stale gate lies.
statements.held_by: tools/consumer_check.py, and the workflow in the consumer's own repository that clones the system at the declared version
statements.provenance: ROADMAP.md C-0, the fourth step; and the fourth step of every absorption

statements.what: A difference is a fact, not a task. The register of deviations records what the system and the field do not agree about, and what each difference is worth; it does not become a queue.
statements.held_by: tools/check_deviations.py, and the probe every closed deviation carries
statements.provenance: core/DEVIATIONS.json — the note; ROADMAP.md D-2

statements.what: A retraction does not erase what it withdraws, and a mark that does not travel to the projections a consumer reads is a failure of the contract, not of the consumer.
statements.provenance: the owner, 2026-10-21 — the right to disqualify retroactively

statements.what: The current native product does not consume the contract: it writes forty-seven colours the contract does not have, uses none of the contract's names, and names no dependency on the contract.
statements.provenance: the measurement, and core/DEVIATIONS.json DEV-020

statements.what: The ancestor repository is not a target of the programme. It is kept for its record, it cannot be qualified in its entirety, and nothing in it is to be brought back to life.
statements.provenance: the owner, 2026-10-21

statements.what: Every colour in this repository is one the contract has, and the sheet's own names name the system rather than carry a colour of their own.
statements.provenance: the qualification — every colour is one of ours

statements.what: The two archived repositories are read-only, so nothing can be absorbed into them and they will not take the contract's components.
statements.provenance: core/DEVIATIONS.json DEV-009; ROADMAP.md C-8

statements.what: The native profile publishes the contract's roles and states as a no-dependency Rust crate, so a native target can read the system without adopting a framework.
statements.provenance: ROADMAP.md A-6

statements.what: The consumer gate reads a consumer's own declaration — its version, its components, its content colours, its scheme — and judges it against the contract's guarantees.
statements.provenance: ROADMAP.md A-1; the first absorption's own gate

statements.what: The eye renders the system's own surfaces and compares the pictures with the ones the system carries, byte for byte, and walks them with axe.
statements.provenance: ROADMAP.md B-3

statements.what: The audit measures every frontend the contract knows: what it uses, what it violates, how far it has come — against the repositories as they are today.
statements.provenance: ROADMAP.md D-3

statements.what: The interchange profile publishes the tokens in the open formats, so a consumer that builds its own pipeline reads the system without adopting this one's.
statements.provenance: ROADMAP.md — the field's own tools, C-0

statements.what: The design board carries the design, and the handoff gate keeps the code in step with it: the same tokens, projected into the board and compared.
statements.provenance: ROADMAP.md B-1 — the board is design work in the repository, and it does not travel with the contract

statements.what: The register of upstream holds what the system's projections and the field's evidence are qualified against: the rails that are watched, the exact revision each is pinned to, and every measured change with the contract element it bears on, whether a projection changes, and the gate that holds the answer.
statements.provenance: the owner's upstream intake, issue 1, 2026-10-21
